title: The Build Lab
summary: Step-by-step guided hardware builds. Learn how to follow diagrams safely.

steps.title: Welcome to the Build Lab
steps.markdownContent:
The **Build Lab** is where the magic happens. This is where you get your hands dirty and wire up real circuits.

Every project has a Build Lab section showing you exactly where to plug in every wire and component.

steps.title: Following the Blueprint
steps.markdownContent:
Build Lab diagrams are step-by-step blueprints.

Instead of throwing a complex diagram at you, Monster Lab breaks it down. You'll add one wire or part at a time, making it impossible to get lost.

steps.title: Will It Work?
steps.markdownContent:
Always check your work before powering on. If you miss a wire, the circuit won't work.

steps.title: Checking Your Ground
steps.markdownContent:
The most common mistake in the Build Lab is a disconnected **Ground (GND)** wire.

If ground is disconnected, electricity can't flow. Practice finding the ground problem in the circuit below.

questions.question: What do you do in the Build Lab?
options: Follow step-by-step diagrams to wire up physical circuits
questions.explanation: The Build Lab gives you the blueprints to construct your hardware.
